chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sukuni, from Ja'far, from his father, from 'Ali عليه السلام, who said:
There is no qisas between slaves and free persons in matters short of the life, and there is no qisas between the Jew, the Christian, and the Magian in matters short of the life.

key_terms.الْأَحْرَارِ: free persons; those not in bondage
key_terms.فِيمَا دُونَ النَّفْسِ: in matters less than life; non-fatal injuries

ai.seo_question: Does qisas apply in non-fatal injuries between slaves and free persons or between Jews, Christians, and Magians?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a legal ruling concerning qisas in cases involving injuries less than killing. It states that qisas does not apply between slaves and free persons, nor between the Jew, the Christian, and the Magian, in matters falling short of life.
